intro: A Los Angeles trio of synthesizers and post-punk.
story: Automatic is a Los Angeles trio formed in 2017 by Izzy Glaudini, Lola Dompé and Halle Saxon, playing synth-driven post-punk on Stones Throw Records. Signal came out in 2019, and Excess in June 2022, the year they played Pickathon; Mojo heard their sparse minimalism as edgy drive. Is It Now?, their third album, arrived in July 2025, they toured internationally through late 2026, and they came back to the farm in 2026.
artist_reel_line: One Thursday evening at Cherry Hill; Is It Now? in 2025, and the farm again in 2026.

intro: A Calgary singer and songwriter, between bluegrass and country.
story: Bella White is a Calgary-born, Nashville-based singer and songwriter raised on bluegrass by a Virginia-native father. Her debut, Just Like Leaving, was self-released in 2020, recorded in Vermont and produced by Patrick M'Gonigle, and Rounder reissued it in 2021. She played Pickathon in 2022 and returned in 2024. Among Other Things, also on Rounder, came in 2023, and A Sign in the Weather in 2026, and she has a headline run in Texas this December and Treefort in 2027.
artist_reel_line: Saturday and Sunday on the farm; later Rounder Records, and a Texas headline run.

intro: Hannah Read's tender indie rock from Texas.
story: Lomelda is Hannah Read, born in Silsbee, Texas and now in Los Angeles, who has made tender indie rock for Double Double Whammy: Thx in 2017, M for Empathy in 2019 and Hannah in 2020, which she recorded three times before it was done and which made ten year-end lists. She played Pickathon in 2022. In 2025 Thx came back as a vinyl reissue, and in late 2026 she headlined club shows in New York.
artist_reel_line: A Saturday in the Woods and a Sunday at the Galaxy Barn; Thx back on vinyl in 2025.
